note: ALA-LC Azerbaijani Romanization Table, 2017 version, pp. 6-7 (Cyrillic script section); held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-azerbaijani.pdf. Extraction: PDF text layer, every value cell cross-checked against the rendered page image. Tesh-ligature digraphs (TS͡/ts͡, IU͡/iu͡, IA͡/ia͡, U+0361) and candrabindu values (I̐/i̐, I + U+0310) transcribed as printed. The lower-case ҝ vernacular cell carries a parenthetical variant glyph that is illegible at 600 dpi and smudged in the print itself; it belongs to the vernacular column, not the romanization, and is documented here rather than transcribed. The map is the 1997 table; the only locally-held printed source is the 2017 version (the table page lists "Earlier versions: 2011, 1997"); the letter table matches the map's encoding and the version difference is recorded here. Skipped printed rows: ъ/ь — the printed value cells read "ʺ (hard sign)" / "ʹ (soft sign)"; the descriptors are stripped and the sign characters transcribed as printed. Canonical-equivalence notes: Ө: printed glyph "Ȯ"; the runtime emits the canonically equivalent byte form 'Ȯ'; the row is stored in the runtime's byte form so the byte-exact embedded test passes. | ө: printed glyph "ȯ"; the runtime emits the canonically equivalent byte form 'ȯ'; the row is stored in the runtime's byte form so the byte-exact embedded test passes. E3 corpus-fixes round (2026-11-17, maps PR e3-fixes-maps): all 19 failing rows above are now encoded in the map and pass — the 8 missing letter pairs (Ё/ё Ë/ë, Ц/ц TS͡/ts͡, Щ/щ Shch/shch, Ъ/ъ ʺ, Ь/ь ʹ, Э/э Ė/ė, Ю/ю IU͡/iu͡, Я/я IA͡/ia͡) added as rules, and the two divergent cells re-voiced to the printed values (Й/й Y/y -> Ĭ/ĭ; ј ı̐ -> i̐); the rows are part of the generated set and this note replaces the per-row findings record. The map's three pre-existing internet-sourced example tests carried the old ı̐ value in their expected strings and were updated to i̐ with the fix.
